about.description: VERT Capital provides tokenized access to private credit and structured finance products, connecting institutional lenders with decentralized liquidity. It enables securitization of off-chain credit through on-chain smart contracts.
about.registryInfo: VERT Capital (Brazil, CVM-registered securitizadora) is a São Paulo-based credit-rights securitization company. Issues tokenized CRAs (Certificados de Recebíveis do Agronegócio) and similar credit-rights certificates on Plume/Ethereum, with tranching (senior, mezzanine, junior) per Brazilian securities law.

fees.revenueNotes: VERT earns securitization-structuring fees on each issuance and ongoing servicing/admin fees, consistent with the Brazilian CVM 88 securitizadora fee model.
